Pin each action to its 40-character commit SHA, and keep the tag as a trailing comment. Based on learnings: "reference third-party actions by pinning to a full commit SHA … rather than a mutable tag or branch."

Review comments at @packages/openplanner-sdk/src/ingest.ts: - Around line 211-213: Validate every event in the batch before starting any writes: move the `validateEvent` pass ahead of the loop that calls `appendEvent` and starts hot-vector tasks. Keep event acceptance and subsequent graph and projection writes unchanged so an invalid event prevents all batch writes. Review comments at @packages/openplanner-sdk/src/mongo-browse.ts: - Around line 60-63: Update queryCollectionResponse to recursively reject filters containing $where, $function, or $accumulator before database operations, and apply a bounded maxTimeMS to both countDocuments and find. Keep the existing filter handling for permitted filters. Review comments at @packages/openplanner-sdk/src/protocol-adapters.ts: - Around line 200-210: Update setPolicy so created_at is excluded from the document passed to $set and initialized with $setOnInsert instead; keep updated_at in $set so existing policies retain their original creation time. --- Nitpick comments: Review comments at @.github/workflows/scoped-graph-recall.yml: - Around line 17-34: Update the five action references in the workflow—actions/checkout, actions/setup-java, DeLaGuardo/setup-clojure, pnpm/action-setup, and actions/setup-node—to use their full 40-character commit SHAs instead of mutable tags, retaining each current tag as a trailing comment.
